  onFile?(page: PageData, options: BuildOptions): Promise<PageData>;

| Hook | When Invoked | Signature |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| `onStart` | Before anything | `(options)` |
| `beforeBuild` | After `onStart`, before file processing | `(options)` |
| `onFile` | Per-file pipeline (ordered) | `(page, options) → PageData` |

- Reports build stats when incremental mode is on
